narr: A weakening upper level low pressure area moved into far southeast South Dakota by early evening. Slow moving thunderstorms developed within a very narrow axis which nosed into Buena Vista County, where the environment featured maximized and collocated 0-3km shear and 0-3km CAPE, and resulted in a few brief tornadoes connected with storm development phase. In addition, very efficient thermodynamic profiles resulted in extremely heavy rainfall rates, with observed rates up to 2 to 3 inches per hour.
ev: A basement wall collapsed due to heavy rainfall and resultant flooding. Property damage costs are a rough estimate.
Multiple rural roads south of Albert City were inundated by water.
Water encroached into several basements around Albert City.
